notes: Plan 2026-10-18: the reader exists (bl_land.last_push_failure over distill.log, imported, not changed). Run against this host's main checkout on 2026-10-18 the last outcome was 'apply --push: git fetch origin failed; nothing pushed' (a connection reset): with every failure an alert it would fire now, hence gate which. A refused push writes DISABLED in the query log directory; that also alerts. Alert line (operator's layout): colour `ESC[1;97;41m!! ALERT {message} — since {HH:MM}ESC[K ESC[0m`; NO_COLOR `!! ALERT {message} — since {HH:MM}`, then a row of W `=`, the header on line 3. Only blocking failures alert; a fetch or connection failure is a `! ` row in its panel.
